question:
By folding the given paper, which of the following box cannot be made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b2348803b8fca2c0342b82877fc5c00703bec7fbe50a3094a6bf4937948aab5.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89fb099d1b0d60553fb7eb1f966187147047f0e132c5b025e3a539fec0d7982e.png] 

P and T is the opposite sides.

Q and S is the opposite sides.

R and U is the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4409c2292513cfafc7b925765c87d15ed8bf6df2b1cb6e67247934463d87f7aa.png] → Can be made, because no opposite sides in the given Dice.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1468843e14df28f2add3e8412c4835944e24f8a3930a5c1bc95ad6cfb5f77537.png] → Can be made, because no opposite sides in the given Dice.

**Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fe99d34593f3f8ae2400b7d846bf851f907f6baecfde69fac6861f146e58e1f.png] → Can not be made, because Q and S are the opposite sides.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31f688ef4331b99fedf088d02e106abed26e3c62de471e254108fd3d4b02a469.png] → Can be made, because no opposite sides in the given Dice.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
